user.title: Connect FeiNiu Music
user.description: Connect the official music service using a regular music account. No NAS administrator account is needed. Use the server root or /music/ URL.

reauth_confirm.title: Update music password
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the password for the existing music account. Leave blank to keep the saved password. To change server or username, remove this source and add it again.

reconfigure.title: Update music password
reconfigure.description: The server and username are fixed for this source. Leave blank to keep the saved password. To change server or username, remove this source and add it again.

outputs.title: Select queue outputs
outputs.description: Create an independent FeiNiu queue for each selected output. Outputs must play HTTP audio from HA; advertised features do not guarantee all formats. Different protocol entities for the same speaker may conflict. Leave empty to use only the media source.

error.invalid_auth: The music account could not log in.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the music service.
error.invalid_input: Enter a valid music URL, username and password.
error.invalid_response: The music service returned an unexpected response.
error.invalid_output: Output cannot play media or contains a wrapper loop.

abort.already_configured: This server and music account are already configured.
abort.identity_change: To change server or music account, remove the old source and add it again. You can update the password for this source.

outputs.title: Select queue outputs
outputs.description: Create an independent FeiNiu queue for each selected output. Outputs must play HTTP audio from HA; advertised features do not guarantee all formats. Different protocol entities for the same speaker may conflict. Leave empty to use only the media source.

playback.title: Choose a FeiNiu player
playback.description: Each FeiNiu player has independent start and end detection settings. Other outputs are unaffected. The music card is not required.

playback_profile.title: Playback compatibility
playback_profile.description:
**{player}**

`{entity_id}`

Applies only to this player. Saving does not restart playback, clear the queue or change speaker firmware settings. Defaults use audio delivery or fresh progress to confirm playback and idle to detect completion. Paused/off and weak feedback can mistake manual pauses or stops for completion; enable only for verified devices.

data.play_once: Send one extra play after loading
data.weak_end: Allow end-state continuation without reliable progress

data_description.confirmation: Default: audio delivery or fresh device progress. Trust playing reports only when the output reports reliably.
data_description.end_state: Default: idle. Paused and off often reflect user actions rather than natural completion.
data_description.play_once: Off by default. Enable only for outputs that need another play command after loading.
data_description.weak_end: Off by default. Continuing on end state alone can mistake manual stops for completion.

error.invalid_output: Output cannot play media or contains a wrapper loop.
error.invalid_profile: Invalid playback preferences. Check the values and try again.

abort.not_loaded: Load the FeiNiu Music integration before configuring playback.
abort.no_outputs: Select output players in integration options first.
abort.output_removed: This player was removed or is reloading. Reopen options.
abort.storage_unavailable: Queue storage needs repair before preferences can be saved. The original file is preserved.

select_outputs.title: Select FeiNiu queue outputs
select_outputs.description: Open integration options to select outputs. No speaker was selected automatically. The media source is still available.

queue_storage.title: Queue storage needs repair
queue_storage.description: The original file is preserved and will not be overwritten. Back it up and follow the queue recovery steps in the README. Queue persistence is unavailable until repaired.
